text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
When she's with Hana, Mimi seems like a real big sis!
Could I be someone's big sis like that, too?
How would I even start?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハナちゃんと居るときのミミ、
すっごくお姉ちゃんだったよね！
ミソギもあんな風にお姉ちゃんになれるかな？
どうやったらなれると思う？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Teach them tricks?
Then we'd get along in no time!
But hang on, wouldn't that make me more of a teacher than a sister?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イタズラを教えるの？
それならすぐに仲良しになれるね！
けどそれ、
お姉ちゃんっていうより
師匠なんじゃないかな……？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Kind, huh...
Can't really play tricks then, can I?
...That's too hard for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
優しくか～
じゃあイタズラしちゃダメだよね～
……できる気がしない！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Brave, huh...
Then I'll go exploring to build up courage!
You're coming too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼もしくか～
いっぱい探検して、
頼もしくなるぞ～！
にいちゃんも手伝ってよね！
